findings.claim: 墨西哥反壟斷機關（CFCE，現 Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio）於 2025 年 8 月結案：指出 Amazon Mexico 與 Mercado Libre 的 Buy Box 演算法及物流整合有潛在疑慮，但未課處矯正措施；10-K 並提醒拉美監管機關可能再啟新調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: In August 2025, the Mexican antitrust authority (Comisión Federal de Competencia Económica, now the Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio) concluded its proceeding regarding alleged barriers to competition in the e-commerce market in Mexico. The authority identified potential concerns related to the operation of Buy Box algorithms and the integration of logistics services by Amazon Mexico and Mercado Libre, however, no corrective measures were imposed and the proceeding was closed.

findings.claim: 2026 年 6 月報導：阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯省對 Mercado Libre 的定型化契約條款展開消費者保護調查（非反壟斷），初期階段，公司否認指控。
findings.excerpt: el Ministerio de Producción bonaerense informó que detectó más de diez cláusulas que podrían infringir la Ley de Defensa del Consumidor.

note: 未查到 2026 年新的反壟斷調查、拆分或 DOJ/FTC/EU 案件；第三次搜尋未執行。
